citations.assessment: The corresponding Rabbah article explicitly preserves Rabbah versus Rava in the witnesses. The printed Bavli has Rava and the checked Ein Yaakov prints Rabbah in parentheses next to bracketed Rava.

holds.reason: The directly matching Rav Naḥman encounter in Shevuot names Rav Ulla son of Rav Ilai. Compare the separate Ulla headword. It does not establish a hearing for Ilai himself.
